editorial:
Imagine two total goofballs who happen to be hunchbacks spending their Halloween night digging up a grave. Instead of gold, they find a weird old horror tape buried with their Uncle Munger. They decide to host a little movie night for their other monster buddies, and that is how you get into the actual stories. The whole vibe is like a spooky sleepover where everyone is a bit slow but very funny. It feels like a lost relic from the eighties, which makes sense since it took years to actually finish and release.

You will probably love how silly the acting is and the weird creature effects that give it a handmade feel. While some of the shorter stories drag a bit, the funny banter between the monsters keeps you interested. If you enjoy campy horror that does not take itself too seriously, you should definitely check this out. It is best experienced as a group activity, so try renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you love collecting rare oddities. It looks surprisingly sharp in high definition for such a strange film.
endingExplained: After the monster friends finish watching all the scary stories on the tape, things take a funny turn. The hunchbacks realize that the tape was actually a warning left by Uncle Munger. In a final twist, the monsters find themselves trapped inside the very movie they were watching. They end up as characters in a new CreepTales story, leaving the viewer laughing at their bad luck as the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s B-movies and goofy monsters.
